notes: Recovery model rebuilt on the research: training-status-dependent repair time and MPS decay, evidence-based per-muscle factors (Chen 2011, Paulsen 2012), body-mass-scaled protein saturation (Moore 2015), sleep anchored to Lamon 2021 and protein to Morton 2018. Each figure links to its paper, a 'how it works' method+changelog sheet was added, and you can now set the training time of past sessions.
